Development Molecules: a small pattern + DI helper to add the client's post-MVP micro-requirements in isolated classes (one per file), behind a single facade, touching the MVP with one line of code.

.NET MAUI adapter for LiquidGlass: a GlassSurface view that refracts the app's own MAUI content on Android and Windows, drawn by the production shaders through SkiaSharp.Views.Maui. iOS is not a target.

Snakemake/Nextflow-style workflow engine in C#: rules with file and in-memory inputs and outputs, wildcards over sample sheets, scatter/gather, a DAG with parallel scheduling and resources, retries, timeouts, incremental re-runs from content hashes, atomic outputs, shell and in-process steps, event…

Cloud data connectors for NCBI E-utilities, UniProt, RCSB PDB, AlphaFold DB and Ensembl REST, with per-host rate limiting, retries and an on-disk/in-memory response cache with offline mode. Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios, dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.

GPU kernels on ILGPU (CUDA, OpenCL, CPU accelerator): all-vs-all Smith-Waterman scoring and batched Vina-style docking, with automatic fallback to the Rust/managed CPU path. Dibuat oleh Gravicode Studios, dipimpin oleh Kang Fadhil.

A self-configuring sync engine for SQL tables Azure SQL Data Sync can't handle - nvarchar(max)/varbinary(max) indexed keys, rows over Data Sync's 24 MB batch limit. Give it a table name; it introspects the schema, derives a sync plan, and generates reviewable SQL.

Manual schema-scaffolding CLI for SmartTableSync - introspects a table (or generates the shared tracking infrastructure) and writes reviewable .sql files. Never executes anything against a database itself.
